description: Historical chain distribution of a wallet's ETH/WETH across networks, as it was `months` ago. The CURRENT distribution comes free with reputa_analyze_wallet; every historical look-back (3, 6, 12, 24 months) is paid per-use via x402 (USDC on Polygon); auto-pays if REPUTA_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY is set.

months.description: Look-back window in months (3, 6, 12 or 24) - all historical windows are paid.

name: reputa_chain_history
